design: Freeze H259 selected fits. Intervene pre'=pre-scale*head_write; angle control lies in same head output span with same norm and dot product to pre. Recompute RMS. Predict residual change C(x')-C(x), compare to [native(x')-compiled(x')]-[native(x)-compiled(x)]. Conditional mediation patches compiled change+predicted residual change onto native intact MLP write at changed residual. Native source target pre'+native(x'); frozen-MLP baseline pre'+native(x). No inference-time native residual in predictor; common native baseline is explicitly diagnostic.

gates.residual_response_transfer: Quadratic sensitivity residual-change fidelity>=.20 on actual sources at BOTH scales, pooled over all9 heads and documents; document-bootstrap95 lower bound>0.
gates.behavioral_transfer: Quadratic sensitivity improves exact conditional KL over compiler-only change by>=.10 relative at BOTH actual scales, paired document-bootstrap95 lower bound>0.
gates.quadratic_advantage: Quadratic sensitivity exceeds affine sensitivity residual-change fidelity by>=.05 at BOTH actual scales with paired document-bootstrap95 lower bound>0.

scope: Same128 H259 evaluation documents reused, new interventions. No retraining or model selection. Pooled and per-head results, document bootstrap retains9 heads. One fixed angle draw per head; intervals conditional on controls. This is final-layer local source/MLP mediation, not full-network retraining or entire-circuit intervention.
